newsitem.title: USA: Texas Water mulling $200 mln to $250 mln Oct. sale.
newsitem.headline: Texas Water mulling $200 mln to $250 mln Oct. sale.

text.p: Texas Water Development Board may issue $200 million to $250 million of waste water bonds in October, an official there said.

The Water Board sells bonds and uses the proceeds to make loans to Texas localities that need money for projects, J. Kevin Ward, deputy executive administrator of the office of project finance and construction assistance, said.
Houston has requested a $175 million loan to fund its Greater Houston Wastewater Program, Ward said.
"It's just another phase of that," he said. "A lot of it's reimbursement of commercial paper."
Morgan Stanley & Co will serve as senior manager.
"They were selected...to be senior manager on our waste water bonds for this entire year," Ward said.
